SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year
FROM dim_date
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, MIN(period_start_date) as q_start, MAX(period_end_date) as q_end
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.subcategory,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) as units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) / SUM(f.quantity), 2) as return_rate_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
GROUP BY p.subcategory
ORDER BY p.subcategory

-- Check date range of Q1 FY2025/26 to verify data coverage
SELECT MIN(calendar_date) as period_start, MAX(calendar_date) as period_end, COUNT(*) as days_in_quarter
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_quarter = 1

-- Check if all quarters in FY2025/26 are fully loaded

FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
